mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is a continuous predictor of S&P 500 returns: a lower rate (per unit change) is associated with higher forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.5% signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% and the quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 0.5%, it signals a strong labor market and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% AND GDPC1 growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth > 3.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to inflation-driven monetary tightening and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The industrial production index (INDPRO) level has a positive correlation with S&P 500 returns: a higher INDPRO level is associated with higher forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1600 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which is associated with reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1600, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 1-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1650 thousand units, it signals a strong housing market and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1650, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
